channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: The political and personal case for Linux
item.description: As tariffs and tech demand drive up computer prices, Thomas L. Knapp argues most everyday users can skip new hardware costs by moving their existing PCs and Macs to free, easy-to-use Linux.

item.title: Combating societal amnesia about disease and vaccines
item.description: As measles resurges in the U.S. amid vaccine skepticism and RFK Jr.’s HHS leadership, one grandparent-led advocacy group is fighting societal amnesia about once-deadly childhood diseases.

item.title: Poll highlights challenges for NC education reformers
item.description: A new Carolina Journal Poll finds NC voters back school choice and higher teacher pay, but see per-pupil spending as too low and are wary of tying education dollars to student performance.

item.title: Boykin will serve us well as sheriff
item.description: Wilson resident Horace “Shorty” Joyner endorses longtime law enforcement officer Chris Boykin for sheriff, urging voters to back a non-politician over a handpicked candidate.

item.title: Area Calendar, Feb. 19-20, 2026
item.description: Area sports schedule for Feb. 19-20, 2026, featuring Conference Carolinas swimming, Barton home and road events, high school basketball tournaments and NCHSAA wrestling at Greensboro Coliseum.

item.title: Wolfpack's 3-point barrage, defense fuel blowout of rival No. 16 Heels
item.description: Short-handed No. 16 North Carolina was no match for N.C. State, as the Wolfpack buried 9 threes, dominated turnovers and points in the paint, and rolled 82-58 for its largest win over UNC since 1962.

item.title: Choosing discipline over regret in sports, work and everyday life
item.description: Former Duke goalkeeper E.J. Proctor reflects on choosing discipline over regret in training, work, and relationships, arguing small daily sacrifices can align us with the people we hope to become.

item.title: Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week: Samaria Miller, Sallie B. Howard School
item.description: Sallie B. Howard sophomore Samaria Miller is the Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week after top-10 finishes at the NCHSAA 1-A/2-A indoor meet and maintaining a 4.29 GPA.

item.title: Buzzer-beater 3 by Chowan snaps Barton’s six-game win streak in 56-53 heartbreaker
item.description: Chowan’s Yasmine Brown hit a buzzer-beater 3 to edge Barton 56-53 at Wilson Gym, snapping the Bulldogs’ six-game win streak despite Layne Sleight’s tying triple and 21-point effort.

item.title: Bulldogs dominate Hawks from tip for 4th straight win, 89-75
item.description: Barton men’s basketball never trailed in an 89-75 win over Chowan, fueled by hot perimeter shooting and 24 points from Isaiah Davis for a fourth straight victory and a stronger grip on fourth in the East Division.
